notes: All 11 source and 14 target ids are partitioned exactly once.
No correlative *so* stands, so καθώς keeps *even as* headed on *as* and the intensifying καί takes *also* on its own (rules 82, 65).
εἷς τὸν ἕνα splits into *each* / ∅ / *other* under rule 2, the article having no determiner to anchor; rule 93 would in any case bar an article from a fused unit.
